works.heading: Interior Design Project Photography — Selected Works
works.summary: Space photography of completed homes and interior design projects, focused on natural light, proportion and lived-in feel, for designer portfolios and proposals.

story.p1: The homeowner moves into their dream home; the designer completes a work to be proud of.
story.p2: I kept wondering — could this happiness reach a little further?
story.p3: So this project was born: designers donate the photography budget to a charity, and I do the shooting.
story.p4: So that finishing one home can do a little good for many more people.
story.closing: You donate, I photograph — a home's happiness keeps flowing.

plans.heading: Interior Photography Plans & Charity Donation Thresholds
plans.intro: No photography fee — once your slot is confirmed, donate directly to a charity.
plans.donationClarify: The NT$12,000 / 18,000 amounts below are donation thresholds paid directly to a charity — not a photography fee charged by SitePhoto. Taipei City only, Saturday and Sunday bookings.

faq.a: There is no photography fee. Donation thresholds depend on size: up to 100 m² NT$12,000 (12 retouched photos), 100–200 m² NT$18,000 (20 retouched photos), paid directly to a charity.

faq.q: Why don't I pay a photography fee?
faq.a: Designers donate their photography budget to a charity and I provide the shoot. The money never passes through SitePhoto.
Charity shoots are limited to Taipei City. Other areas or commercial commissions: please enquire separately.
Shoots are by appointment on Saturdays and Sundays only.
Fill in the form below. Donate only after your slot and date are confirmed.

plans.bookingNote: Shoots are by appointment, with slots on Saturdays and Sundays.
plans.prepNote: The space must be finished, cleaned, and staged before the shoot — cleaning and styling services are not included.
plans.guideHeading: Before the shoot, know what to expect
plans.guideDescription: Site preparation, shoot-day cooperation, retouch scope, and photo delivery.
plans.footnote: For spaces over 200 m², special venues, or commercial commissions, please enquire separately. Deliverables and dates are confirmed case by case.
plans.warning: Apply first, and donate only after your slot is confirmed — not before.

apply.dateLabel: Preferred shoot date (Sat & Sun slots only)
apply.dateHint: Weekends only — other days snap to Saturday.

thanks.p1: Thanks for supporting SitePhoto. I'll reply by email with the shoot terms and available dates.

direct.label: 委託人直接捐給公益機構

story.p1: 屋主住進理想的家，設計師完成值得驕傲的作品。
story.p2: 我一直在想，這份幸福能不能繼續向外延伸？
story.p3: 於是有了這個計畫：由設計師將攝影預算捐給公益機構，我則負責拍攝。
story.p4: 讓一個家的完成，也能為更多人帶來一點好事。
story.closing: 你捐款，我拍照。讓家的幸福，繼續流動。

plans.heading: 室內空間攝影方案與公益捐款門檻
plans.intro: 不用支付攝影服務費。確認名額後，直接捐款給公益機構即可。
plans.donationClarify: 下方 NT$12,000／18,000 為直接捐贈給公益機構的捐款門檻，並非 SitePhoto 收取的攝影費。服務範圍僅限台北市，採週六、週日預約制。

faq.q: 室內空間攝影價格怎麼計算？
faq.a: 公益攝影不收攝影服務費，依坪數設有捐款門檻：30 坪以內 NT$12,000（12 張精修照片）、31–60 坪 NT$18,000（20 張精修照片），由委託人直接捐給公益機構。

faq.q: 為什麼不是支付攝影費？
faq.a: 這是一項公益攝影計畫：設計師將攝影預算直接捐給公益機構，我則提供拍攝服務，款項不經過 SitePhoto。

faq.q: 台北哪些區域可以預約？
faq.a: 公益攝影僅限台北市範圍內的案場。超出範圍或商業委託請另外洽詢。
目前拍攝採預約制，僅開放週六、週日場次。
於本頁下方填寫申請表單，確認可承接與拍攝日期後才會進行捐款，確認名額前請勿捐款。

plans.warning: 請先申請並確認名額，再進行捐款。確認名額前請勿捐款。

story.p1: 施主は理想の住まいへ。デザイナーは誇れる作品を手にする。
story.p2: この幸せを、もっと外へ広げられないだろうか——そう考え続けていました。

story.p4: 一つの家の完成が、より多くの人の小さな良いことになりますように。
story.closing: あなたが寄付し、私が撮る。住まいの幸せを、これからも循環させていく。
